processed_hadiths.english_translation: Ibn Wahb informed me, from Yunus, from Ibn Shihab, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was leading the people in prayer, and there was a pit in front of them. Then a man approached who had something ugly in his eyes (visually impaired), and the people kept looking at him as he came toward them, until he reached the pit and fell into it. When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ finished (the prayer), he said: 'Whoever among you laughed, let him repeat the prayer.' And al-Layth ibn Sa'd said this (as well).

processed_hadiths.english_translation: Chapter heading: Spitting in the Mosque

Narrated by Abu Hurayrah: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw mucus or phlegm in the qiblah (direction) of the mosque, so he scraped it off - Shu'bah said: once or twice, or he commanded me and I scraped it off - then he said: 'Would any of you like to have mucus or spit in his face? When one of you prays, let him not spit in the qiblah in front of him, nor to his right, but to his left. If he does not find (a place), then let him spit like this,' and Shu'bah rubbed it with his hand on his garment. Narrated by Anas ibn Malik: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Spitting in the mosque is a sin, and its expiation is to bury it.'

processed_hadiths.english_translation: Statement of Malik: I dislike killing fleas and lice in the mosque. And Malik said: Whoever finds a louse while in prayer should not kill it in the mosque, nor throw it there, whether in prayer or not. If he is outside the mosque, there is no harm in discarding it. Narrated by 'Amir regarding a man who has a louse crawling on him during prayer, he said: 'Let him leave it alone.'

processed_hadiths.arabicText: قَالَ : وَقَالَ مَالِكٌ فِي الرَّجُلِ يَقْنُتُ فِي الصُّبْحِ قَبْلَ الرُّكُوعِ وَلَا يُكَبِّرُ لِلْقُنُوتِ . قَالَ : وَقَالَ مَالِكٌ فِي الْقُنُوتِ فِي الصُّبْحِ : كُلُّ ذَلِكَ وَاسِعٌ قَبْلَ الرُّكُوعِ وَبَعْدَ الرُّكُوعِ , قَالَ مَالِكٌ : وَالَّذِي آخُذُ بِهِ فِي خَاصَّةِ نَفْسِي قَبْلَ الرُّكُوعِ . قَالَ : وَقَالَ مَالِكٌ فِيمَنْ نَسِيَ الْقُنُوتَ فِي صَلَاةِ الصُّبْحِ , قَالَ : لَا سَهْوَ عَلَيْهِ . قَالَ مَالِكٌ : وَلَيْسَ فِي الْقُنُوتِ دُعَاءٌ مَعْرُوفٌ ، وَلَا وُقُوفٌ مُوَقَّتٌ , قَالَ مَالِكٌ : وَلَا بَأْسَ أَنْ يَدْعُوَ الرَّجُلُ بِجَمِيعِ حَوَائِجِهِ فِي الْمَكْتُوبَةِ حَوَائِجِ دُنْيَاهُ وَآخِرَتِهِ فِي الْقِيَامِ وَالْجُلُوسِ وَالسُّجُودِ , قَالَ : وَكَانَ يَكْرَهُ فِي الرُّكُوعِ . قَالَ : وَأَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكٌ ، عن عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ ، قَالَ : بَلَغَنِي عنهُ ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ : " إِنِّي لَأَدْعُو اللَّهَ فِي حَوَائِجِي كُلِّهَا فِي الصَّلَاةِ حَتَّى فِي الْمِلْحِ "

processed_hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Abu Rafi': The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Ask Allah for your needs absolutely in the Fajr prayer.' Malik said: There is no harm in supplicating to Allah during prayer against the oppressor and supplicating for others, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ supplicated in prayer for some people and against others. Another chain: While the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was supplicating against Mudar, Jibril came to him and gestured to him to be silent, so he became silent. Then he said: 'O Muhammad, Allah did not send you as one who curses and reviles, but rather sent you as a mercy and did not send you as a punishment. [Quran verse:] It is not for you [O Muhammad] of the matter at all - whether He should [cut short their lives and] forgive them or punish them, for indeed, they are wrongdoers.' Then he taught him this qunut: 'O Allah, we seek Your help, and Your forgiveness, and we believe in You, and we submit to You, and we abandon and forsake whoever disbelieves in You. O Allah, You alone we worship, and to You we pray and prostrate, and to You we hasten and compete, we hope for Your mercy and fear Your severe punishment, indeed Your severe punishment will overtake the disbelievers.'

processed_hadiths.english_translation: Statement of Ibn al-Qasim: We asked Malik about a man who is in prayer and thinks he has had hadath (broken wudu) or had a nosebleed, so he leaves to wash the blood or to make wudu, then it becomes clear to him after that he was not affected by any of that. He said: He returns and begins the prayer anew and does not build upon it. Malik said: Whoever has hadath after the tashahhud but before making salam must repeat the prayer.

processed_hadiths.arabicText: قَالَ ابْنُ الْقَاسِمِ : قُلْنَا لِمَالِكٍ فِي الرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ فِي الصَّلَاةِ ، فَيَظُنُّ أَنَّهُ قَدْ أَحْدَثَ أَوْ رَعَفَ ، فَيَنْصَرِفُ لِيَغْسِلَ الدَّمَ عنهُ أَوْ لِيَتَوَضَّأَ ، ثُمَّ تَبَيَّنَ لَهُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يُصِبْهُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ شَيْءٌ ؟ قَالَ : يَرْجِعُ فَيَسْتَأْنِفُ الصَّلَاةَ وَلَا يَبْنِي . قَالَ : فَإِنَّ قَوْلَ مَالِكٍ عندَنَا : إِنَّ الْإِمَامَ إِذَا قَطَعَ صَلَاتَهُ مُتَعَمِّدًا أَفْسَدَ عَلَى مَنْ خَلْفَهُ الصَّلَاةَ ، أَوْ كَانَ عَلَى طُهْرٍ فَصَلَّى بِهِمَا ، فَأَحْدَثَ فَتَمَادَى وَصَلَّى بِهِمْ ، فَإِنَّهُ يُفْسِدُ عَلَيْهِمْ . قَالَ : وَقَالَ مَالِكٌ : مَنْ أَحْدَثَ بَعْدَمَا تَشَهَّدَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُسَلِّمَ أَعَادَ الصَّلَاةَ .

processed_hadiths.arabicText: فِيمَنْ صَلَّى الظُّهْرَ ، وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ الْعَصْرُ ، أَوْ يَوْمَ الْخَمِيسِ ، وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ الْجُمُعَةُ

processed_hadiths.english_translation: Statement of Malik: If a man came to the mosque while people were in Dhuhr prayer, but he thought they were in Asr, so he prayed intending Asr, then his prayer is invalid and he must repeat Asr. Ibn al-Qasim said, Malik said: If an imam came to the mosque thinking that people had not prayed Dhuhr, so the prayer was established and he led them in Dhuhr while they intended Asr, the prayer would be Dhuhr for the imam, and they should establish the prayer and he should lead them in Asr. He said: It reached me from Malik that he said regarding a man who came to the mosque on Thursday thinking it was Friday, and entered the mosque while the imam was in Dhuhr prayer, so he commenced prayer with him intending Jumu'ah, and the imam prayed Dhuhr four rak'ahs: I see it as sufficient for him because Jumu'ah is Dhuhr. But if he came to the mosque on Friday thinking it was Thursday, and found the imam in prayer, so he entered with him in prayer intending Dhuhr while the imam prayed Jumu'ah: He said: He must repeat his prayer, and this is my opinion.
